data.name: Dhananjay Bathe
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Dhananjay Bathe has made a big mark in cricket. With 10 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 43*, with an average of 14.00 and a quick strike rate of 113.95. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 2 sixes and 12 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 33.0 overs, taking 14 wickets at an economy rate of 8.97. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
